name: Dire Attenuation
body:
Prerequisite(s): Dire zone class feature.

Benefit(s): Your dire zone is not an exact radius. By excluding one foe from your dire zone, you may select one foe within 5 feet of your dire zone to include in your dire zone. Changing your dire zone’s shape or area from its current shape or area is a move action.
